title: .ssot.yaml manifest
description: Single-source-of-truth manifest: one canonical location per fact plus every hand-copied instance. The ssot-check CLI re-implements these checks in stdlib (validate subcommand); this schema is for editors and CI YAML-linting.

ignore_paths.description: Glob patterns excluded from globbed copy expansion and from discover scans.

repos.description: Named repos that locators reference with `repo: NAME`. Each run resolves a name via --repo NAME=PATH, then $SSOT_REPO_<NAME>, then $SSOT_REPOS_DIR/NAME, then this path (default ../NAME, relative to the root).

path.description: Default checkout location, relative to the root or absolute.

guard_skip_marker.description: Regex (multiline). Files containing a match are skipped by every guard, e.g. a '**Status:** snapshot' header on point-in-time records.

name.description: Short kebab-case identifier for the fact.

note.description: What the fact is, its update cadence, and counting conventions.

type.description: Normalization applied before comparison. Default string is literal (whitespace + trailing '+' only).

monotonic.description: If true and a copy is numerically higher than the canonical, drift is flagged 'canonical suspect' (a count that only grows means the higher value is probably fresher).

freshness.description: Flag the canonical file when its git last-edit date is older than max_age_days.

copies.description: Every other place the value is written. Required unless the fact has a guard; a guarded fact with no copies means every other mention should point to the canonical.

json_path.description: Dot-separated keys and list indexes into a JSON file. A final '#' reads the length of the list or object before it.

guard.description: Scan this repo's prose for the fact's value on the same line as an anchor word. STALE VALUE: a superseded value appears. RESTATED (restated: true): the current value appears outside the canonical and declared copies.

anchors.description: Whole words, case-insensitive. A value is only reported on a line that also contains one.

superseded.description: Old values that must no longer be asserted.

restated.description: Also report the current value (the canonical's value plus also_current) anywhere except the canonical and declared copies.

also_current.description: Other spellings of the current value, e.g. '31K' beside '31,408'. Requires restated: true.

paths.description: Globs to scan. Default: **/*.md, **/*.markdown, **/*.txt, **/*.rst. A trailing '/' means a directory prefix.

exempt.description: Globs or directory prefixes (trailing '/') to skip, on top of ignore_paths.

file.description: Forward-slash path relative to repo root, or to the named repo when 'repo' is set. May escape the root (../sibling) for a cross-repo, read-only location.

pattern.description: Regex with exactly ONE capture group around the value.

repo.description: Name of a repo declared under top-level 'repos'. 'file' is then relative to that repo and may not contain '..' or a glob.

relation.description: floor: the copy is a reader-facing floor that must be at or below the canonical (integer or currency facts only; not with rounding).

max_gap_pct.description: With relation floor: the largest percentage the floor may trail the canonical.

file.description: Copy location. May be a glob (docs/*.md) for local paths.

pattern.description: Regex with exactly ONE capture group around the value.

repo.description: Name of a repo declared under top-level 'repos'. 'file' is then relative to that repo and may not contain '..' or a glob.

rounding.description: Deterministic transform applied to the canonical value before exact comparison, for copies a script intentionally rounds.
